skills.name: Luring Sword
lines: Water type slash attack on a single enemy 3x (M) + Power and Intelligence of target -10% (2 turns: max stack x3 -20%)
* Attacks multiplier +20% if target is afflicted with Pain (Multiplier x1.2)
* Stacks 1 Death Flower Petal on user.
* At 2 Stacks: If HP <100% of default max HP at start of turn - inflict Stun on user (1 turn)
** If stun ends naturally - consume all Death Flower Petals
* Death Flower Petal: Critical rate +10% (max stack: 2, +20%)
** Number of attacks +1 per stack (max stack: 5x (M))
** Multiplier when target is afflicted with Pain +15% per stack (max stack: Multiplier x1.5)
